استهديا (form X)
# اِسْتَهْدَيَا (istahdayā) /is.tah.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اُسْتُهْدِيَا (ustuhdiyā) /us.tuh.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# اِسْتَهْدِيَا (istahdiyā) /is.tah.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
